errors.evidence: Thought: I need to determine which contributor to the version of OpenCV that added Mask-RCNN support has a name which, when transliterated to the Latin alphabet, is the same as that of a former Chinese head of government. To do so, I will ask our search_agent to search for relevant articles or commit logs regarding this OpenCV release and its contributors, with focus on names similar to “Wen Jiabao” (a former Premier of China), as this is the most prominent name that could match among Chinese leaders.
errors.description: The agent hallucinated the existence of a search_agent tool and its capabilities.
